cues.text: Outside the hotel, Fuuka waits by the entrance under a sign reading champs de fleurs. Mitsuru comes out first, then Akihiko, Yukari, you and Junpei, and you all gather around her. Junpei hangs back, looking glum.
Mitsuru turns and walks away down the street, and Akihiko follows her.
Junpei turns his back on you and walks off alone.
Yukari heads off the same way, and Fuuka goes after her, leaving you by the entrance.
